<div class="wv-epigraph">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“Then we must act now. If we Travel through Naraka, surely we can make it.”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|— ''House of Blades'', chapter 16}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Alin Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Alin is the son of [[Torin]] and was born in [[Myria village]], located within the realm governed by [[Malachi|Overlord Malachi]]. Although he initially doubted his status as a [[Traveler]], it is noted that he was born as one of the most powerful Territories. He possesses the ability to manifest light, specifically appearing as misty white-gold or deadly gold light, and can summon creatures from his [[Territory]], such as a winged insect-like entity with a [[steel]] eye. Alin is identified as an [[Incarnation]], and there is speculation regarding his potential power if he were to fully incarnate. Throughout his journey, he interacts with various figures, including [[Simon]] and [[Leah]], and has encountered a [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]]. His experiences involve navigating locations like the shining walls of [[Elysia]] and dealing with significant personal losses, including the death of his sisters.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Alin is a tall and strong individual with hair that gleams like polished gold. He has rainbow-colored eyes consisting of shifting slices of color, though they can change to a blazing gold or luminescent violet. He has been seen wearing heavy gold armor, fine clothes damaged by fire and thorns, and a [[The mask|mask]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Alin is a focused leader and storyteller who possesses an [[aura]] of radiant confidence. He has taken the responsibilities of being a hero to heart and is driven by a desire for results, though he is noted to be a poor liar. He has experienced intense fury and has also been known to meditate on his own virtue.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Alin is the son of [[Torin]] and has sisters who were killed by a powerful creature. He harbors a crush on [[Leah]], whom he accompanied during his escape from [[Malachi]] and intends to rescue from the city. Alin is an ally to [[Simon]], fighting side-by-side with him and lending him a filiar, though [[Simon]] has promised to stop Alin if he takes too much control. He is also connected to [[Grandmaster Naraka]] and [[Gilad]], as well as a second cousin from [[Myria]]. Alin defeated the [[Malachi|Overlord Malachi]] and killed [[Grandmaster Tartarus]], while [[Rhalia]] is an individual who separated Alin's mind from his body. Additionally, Alin has interacted with [[Tamara]] and [[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]], the latter of whom he killed.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|As an [[Elysian Incarnation]] and [[Traveler]], Alin can access various colored lights to manifest different powers. He can summon golden swords of translucent light, meteors of golden power, and a golden hound, or use green light to create protective shields of interlocking plates. Additionally, he can utilize rose-pink light for healing, orange light to soar on wings or lift objects, and violet light to attempt to banish things.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Journey through Elysia}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|While traveling through the city of [[Elysia]] alongside [[Rhalia]], Alin demonstrated the ability to open doors.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c13">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 13</ref> Driven by a craving for light and a desire for recognition from [[Leah]], Alin serves [[Enosh]] and was previously involved in an operation to destroy the [[Hanging Tree]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c13" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c14">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 14</ref> As an employee of the [[Grandmasters]], Alin was present during the negotiations with [[Talos]], where they remained mostly silent while processing the circumstances.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c15">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c16">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 16</ref> Alin possesses the power to summon [[rose light]] and wore armor that was both heavy and hot.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c19">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 19</ref><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c21">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Battle in Ragnarus}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|As Alin prepared to step into [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]], he shook off [[Grandmaster Naraka]] and jogged through the trees.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c22">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 22</ref> While observing the battle between [[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]] and the [[Enosh Travelers]], Alin demonstrated his ability to summon a globe of gold and create two intersecting walls of green plates.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c22" /> During the combat, he used a translucent green light to catch the King's spear and utilized a green wall to recover.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c22" /> Alin also fired a blast of golden light from his off hand and wondered about the price [[Zakareth]] had paid for his strength.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c22" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c23">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 23</ref> After summoning beings from the [[Gold District]], Alin used a [[sword]] of golden light to kill [[Zakareth]] and guessed that the staircase was typically hidden beneath a secret panel in the tile.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c23" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Return to Myria}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|After stepping out of the [[Naraka Gate]] into [[Myria]], Alin returned feeling weary.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c23" /><ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c24">''The Crimson Vault'', chapter 24</ref> He possesses a [[Territory]] from which he can summon golden power and wields a golden [[sword]].<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c24" /> Alin can utilize various colored lights to manipulate his environment, such as using an orange light cushion to catch [[Tamara]] or summoning rose-pink light to heal injuries.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c24" /> His defensive capabilities include manifesting a ten-layer thick shield of interlocking green plates or an instinctive green shield.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c24" /> Alin can augment his body with swirling [[blood]]-red light and use orange light to stop in midair or soar on wings of orange light.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c24" /> He is also capable of bursting into flames, sensing things with silver light, summoning an orb of liquid blue light, calling a golden meteor from the sky, or lifting into the air on sunset wings.<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c24" />}}

{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Alin possesses the ability to fill an entire street with a river of white-hot light, and his eyes have shifted from gold to a luminescent violet.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c13" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c14">''City of Light'', chapter 14</ref> While wielding the [[Lightning Spear]] in his right hand, this powerful and all-but-immortal [[Incarnation]] is no longer classified as a [[Traveler]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c14" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c15">''City of Light'', chapter 15</ref> Wearing a [[The mask|mask]], Alin is capable of intelligible conversation and may have the power to send bears to [[Leah]]'s group or summon the entire army of the City.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c16">''City of Light'', chapter 16</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c22">''City of Light'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25">''City of Light'', chapter 25</ref> As fury pounded in his heart, Alin's skin became a shade paler than ever before.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c26">''City of Light'', chapter 26</ref> Working alongside [[Simon]] provides the best chance to defeat an [[Incarnation]], especially after Alin fought side-by-side with him.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c26" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27">''City of Light'', chapter 27</ref> Having given up his humanity, Alin provided information regarding a house in the [[Violet District]] that could hide people from [[Lirial scouts]] before hovering over the city while glowing with red and orange light.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27" />}}

* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“I’m ordering you to take them out of the city, Simon.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|“Simon, you and I can do things that nobody else here can do.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c17" />}}
